implementation_scope.measured_analogue: Use the same Go standard-library compress/gzip API/version and operation boundaries in standalone memory-backed code. This excludes RCC package dispatch, file opens/writes/renames/permissions, path/hash logic, and does not claim direct LiftFile or gzDelegateOpen package timing.
implementation_scope.rcc_reader: htfs/delegates.go gzDelegateOpen lines 11-33: os.Open, gzip.NewReader, then caller reads; hololib.Open in htfs/library.go delegates with Compress().
implementation_scope.rcc_writer: htfs/functions.go LiftFile lines 223-257: os.Open source; os.Create part file; gzip.NewWriterLevel(sink, gzip.BestSpeed); io.Copy; writer.Close; sink.Close; rename; MakeSharedFile.

phases.name: legacy-gzip-decode
phases.operation: gzip.NewReader(bytes.NewReader(originalStored)); io.ReadAll; Close. Timing includes reader creation, decompression and logical output allocation; excludes provider file read and SHA verification.

phases.name: gzip-bestspeed-encode
phases.operation: gzip.NewWriterLevel(&bytes.Buffer, gzip.BestSpeed); Write(logical); Close. Timing includes writer setup, compression, buffer output and close; excludes input source read/decompression and output SHA/size/roundtrip checks.

phases.name: gzip-bestspeed-decode
phases.operation: Prepare canonical BestSpeed frame outside timer, verify size/SHA against untimed canonical preparation; timed gzip.NewReader(bytes.NewReader(frame)); io.ReadAll; Close. Timing includes reader setup, decompression and output allocation.

schedule.object_order: digest sorted; rotate by repetition+phase index

scope: Standalone Go 1.26.9 standard-library gzip BestSpeed codec components on the exact 20 >1 MiB logical object corpus used by the prior external CPython measurement. No RCC binary/package execution; no producer filesystem path or persistent artifact format change.

source.fixture_provenance: Historical Actions a709 stable RCC3 fixture; main727 is source context only, not fixture producer.
source.selection: exact 20 logicalSize>1048576 objects from immutable prior measurement plan, storedDigest lexicographic order

supervision.launcher: supervise.py uses integer os.statvfs availability; samples `ps -eo pid=,ppid=,rss=` process tree every 100ms for both official Go build and compiled runtime; fails closed on ps/known process visibility errors; enforces free-space floor+4MiB, RSS <=512MiB, own /dev/shm allocated <=256MiB, executable <=8MiB, evidence allocated <=1MiB, 120s overall build+runtime watchdog and 30s per marked runtime phase; records exact build/run numeric subprocess exit codes; kills only its process group on guard failure and records actual reaped status.
supervision.phase_watch: Go runner writes phase.json and append-only phase-events.jsonl on each phase start/completion; Python supervisor checks every100ms, preserves all 30 marker events, and enforces 30s per 20-object phase.
supervision.post_link_metadata: Run official go version -m under the same process-tree/free/RSS/timeout/evidence/RAM-temp guards before executing the compiled workspace binary; preserve exact command output and numeric exit. Reject missing/mismatched Go version, GOOS, GOARCH, or CGO_ENABLED metadata.
supervision.process_rss_scope: Supervisor Python plus Go build/runtime process group and descendants, sampled ps tree every100ms; fail closed on missing supervisor/live child, and continue tracking the child process group after its leader exits.

validation.analysis: Retain raw 300 sample rows with per-object, repetition, phase, wall ns, process CPU ns, input/output bytes, frame SHA+size. Report repetition sums/medians and total timed wall+CPU divided by total logical bytes (byte weighted), sizes and scope boundaries.
validation.per_sample: Reload and validate object outside timer, then verify exact logical SHA+size of timed decode result or encoded frame and roundtrip outside timer. Encode output frame SHA+size must equal canonical frame. For decode-BestSpeed, recreate the frame untimed and match canonical SHA+size before timing.
validation.untimed_preflight: For each stored object verify indexed stored size+SHA, gzip decode, logical size+SHA; make one canonical BestSpeed frame per object and record size+SHA and roundtrip validation. Record index/manifest exact bytes+hash. Before/after repeat stored object/index/manifest hash+size+mode+mtime census; atime excluded/recorded as read side effect.
